# Context Analyzer

> Context window forensics for AI coding agents. Measures exactly where your
> tokens go in Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions — per API call, per turn,
> per session — using API-reported token counts, not estimates. Ships a web
> dashboard, a JSON API, and an MCP server.

Repo: https://github.com/manavgup/context-analyzer
License: MIT · Python 3.11+ · Package name: context-tracker (PyPI publish pending)

## Key findings it surfaces
- Cost per API call scales 4.3x from small to large context ($0.23/call at 63K peak vs $0.98/call at 721K)
- ~30% of context becomes stale dead weight within 5 turns
- Tool I/O consumes 60%+ of used context
- Cache hit rate is 96-98% when the system prompt prefix stays stable

## Install and run
uv tool install context-tracker    # or: pip install context-tracker (after first PyPI publish; until then: git clone + make install-dev)
context-tracker up                 # install Claude Code hooks (reversible, settings.json backed up), ingest existing transcripts, start dashboard at http://localhost:8080
context-tracker up --no-hooks      # dashboard from existing transcripts only, no hooks
context-tracker down               # remove only this tool's hook entries (backup at ~/.claude/settings.json.bak)
context-tracker install|uninstall  # hooks only, no dashboard
context-tracker dashboard          # dashboard only (default port 9201)
context-tracker stats [--share]    # personal stats card from local data
context-tracker                    # MCP server on stdio (also: --transport sse|http, default port 9200)

## Dashboard pages
/           single-session dashboard: context growth, budget lines, cache churn, composition, message inspector
/sessions   cross-session analytics: cost/call vs peak context, insights, trends
/workflows  workflow analysis
/optimize   CLAUDE.md optimizer

## JSON API (FastAPI, selected routes)
GET /api/health
GET /api/sessions                      session list with stats
GET /api/sessions/trends               cross-session aggregation
GET /api/sessions/patterns             efficiency patterns
GET /api/session/{id}/summary
GET /api/session/{id}/data             full session data (blocks + churn)
GET /api/session/{id}/health
GET /api/session/{id}/dead_weight
GET /api/session/{id}/freshness
GET /api/session/{id}/report           post-session optimization report
GET /api/optimize/claude-md

## MCP tools (server: context-tracker, stdio by default)
mcp_get_session_summary, mcp_get_tool_breakdown, mcp_get_compaction_history,
mcp_get_context_hogs, mcp_get_session_history, mcp_get_bloat_events,
mcp_should_clear, mcp_get_staleness_analysis, mcp_get_session_health,
mcp_get_new_session_recommendation, mcp_get_block_lifespans, mcp_get_cache_churn

## Data locations
~/.claude/context-trace/<session_id>.jsonl        hook events (written by installed hooks)
~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session_id>.jsonl   Claude Code transcripts (read for exact token counts)
~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl      Codex CLI sessions (ingested)
~/.context-analyzer/analyzer.db                   SQLite database (auto-ingest on first access)
